items.name: Copper Country Cubing Fall 2019

venue.name: Michigan Tech Memorial Union Building
venue.address: Michigan Tech Memorial Union Building, Houghton, MI 49931, United States
venue.details: Different rooms at different times over three floors, follow signs!

items.information: This will be the second Copper Country Cubing (Michigan Technological University) competition, in Michigan's great Upper Peninsula. The Memorial Union Building (MUB) is located between the middle and west end of the Michigan Tech campus. Check the schedule to see if the events at that time will be in the second floor ballroom, first floor alumni lounge, or ground floor commons. We are excited to be bringing all 18 official WCA events to the area, which doesn't get many competitions. The first CCC competition had only 8 events and 23 competitors, so this time we're making it bigger and better! Friday is reserved for big BLD and feet, so you can arrive just for Saturday and Sunday if you aren't interested in that subset of events.

items.name: UK Championship 2019
items.information: Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. **Qualification Requirements**: If you do not meet the qualification requirements in competition *before* 11 October 2019, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the [Qualification tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UKChampionship2019#9139-qualification) to see all times required. **Final Round Advancements**: For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 3x3x3 with Feet - 4 UK competitors; 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3x3 Cube - 8 UK competitors. **Please Note**: As this is the UK Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.
